messages:
Molly: quick shoutout — whoever set up the impromptu snack stand + sticker swap in the kitchen this morning, you are my hero. tiny morale boost. :tada:
Cheng: omg the hand-drawn llama sticker is peak office culture :laughing:
Jamal: huge props to Facilities and Ana for getting everything up before 9am. that cold brew saved my Monday. :coffee:
Facilities: (Facilities) delighted you liked it! we found the old sticker box in storage and decided to make a micro event. drop extras at reception if you have them. :seedling:
Ana: true story — 1am sticker-printing session in the living room. jamal is the midnight sticker wizard. :grin:
Alex: shoutout to Jamal for the late-night craft hustle and Molly for ordering the extra tape. felt like a tiny festival. :sparkles:
Molly: adding a silly leaderboard on the whiteboard — top sticker contributors: Jamal, Ana, Cheng (tiebreaker = aesthetics). :star2:
Cheng: accepting my ribbon for aesthetic contribution. also thanks to Ops for not yelling about tape residue on the counter. :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: (Deploy bot) FYI: no cookie-related incidents detected during sticker install. all systems nominal. :robot_face:
Sara: also — quick thanks to CX for the 'you crushed it' sticky notes they left by the coffee. saw one and it made my demo nerves vanish. :relieved:
Jamal: honored. bringing a small jar of fortune cookies to the stand tomorrow morning. everyone take one (or two). :cookie:
Molly: micro poll — tomorrow: bagels (breakfast) or cookies (dessert)? react with :bagel: or :cookie: and we'll follow the majority.
Ana: bagels! but maybe leave a cookie box for the late-night crew.
Alex: cookies for me — allergic to gluten but not to kindness. :heart:
Cheng: can't believe we are having a snack democracy. this is peak team vibes. :heart_eyes:
Molly: thanks team — spontaneous kindness > scheduled tokens. end of micro-kudos thread. :clap:
